title: Why We Say Rule of Thumb
short_teaser: The phrase refers broadly to a practical guideline based on experience rather than exact calculation; popular stories about its legal origin are disputed.
story: The phrase refers broadly to a practical guideline based on experience rather than exact calculation; popular stories about its legal origin are disputed. A familiar phrase can accumulate a false history if repetition replaces verification. Words shape what we notice, remember, and make possible together. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
